title_as_printed: Vapour pressures p of water over potassium chloride solutions at temperature T

footnotes_as_printed.a: Dp = p(H2O,T) - p(H2O + KCl, m_sat, T) measured by the differential isoteniscopic method.
footnotes_as_printed.b: p = p(H2O,T) - Dp, where p(H2O,T) is calculated from the Saul and Wagner equation.(14)
footnotes_as_printed.c: Calculated from the Pitzer equation for osmotic coefficients of KCl.(17)
footnotes_as_printed.d: Calculated from the water activity obtained in isopiestic measurements by Stokes and Robinson.(18)

pressure_note: vapour pressure of water over the solution (absolute); direct isoteniscopic for the first 5 rows and one row at 303.95 K; for '*' rows p = p(H2O) from Saul-Wagner minus measured Dp (derived)

value2.what: vapour pressure lowering p(H2O,T) - p(solution), differential isoteniscopic method

composition.other_species: rows with '*' are saturated KCl solutions; molality not measured here (Table 5 gives literature-averaged m_sat, e.g. 4.783 mol/kg at 298.15 K, not extracted)

conversion_needs: rows with '*' need saturation molality from external solubility data (builder or Table 5, derived)
notes: T printed only on first row of each T block and filled down (carried forward) in the CSV; rows 5-9 share 298.15 K. The '*' in the m column is printed text. Row 14 (303.95 K, p 3701.7, no Dp) is printed on its own line. Footnote letters b,d stripped from numbers and recorded in the note column.
